title: Add FT-001 account membership session schema baseline
verify: Account, FarmMembership, and LocalSession records preserve the FT-001 field/status/index constraints.
LocalSession stores token_hash only and has no raw token field.
Migration path creates only FT-001-owned records and does not create Farm, Plant, PlantAccessGrant, public invite, or admin audit behavior.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: no raw session token field evidence
constraints: Store only server-side token_hash for LocalSession; never persist raw session tokens.
Use Account statuses pending_activation, active, disabled and FarmMembership statuses invited, active, disabled.
Do not create Farm, Plant, PlantAccessGrant, public invite, admin mutation, or AdminAuditRecord behavior in this task.
Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: PostgreSQL/read model owns mutable Account, FarmMembership, and LocalSession state.
Secrets/auth material must not enter logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: Check changed code preserves verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline or records a blocker.
purpose: Create the FT-001 persistence baseline for local identity, membership, and sessions without implementing adjacent product features.
success_outcome: Later FT-001 tasks can use stable Account, FarmMembership, and LocalSession records with enforced status/index/token-hash constraints.

stop_conditions: Migration would require destructive database operations.
Schema requires unresolved FT-002 or FT-003 ownership decisions.
Verification cannot prove token_hash-only session storage.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
